responsibility: Implements rs6000 hooks used by the C-family front ends for PowerPC-specific language behavior. Its responsibilities include handling #pragma longcall, defining target preprocessor macros and conditional AltiVec keywords, setting up target vector and __int128 language types, and most notably resolving overloaded AltiVec/VSX builtin calls from front-end trees by checking argument types, target feature availability, and special-case intrinsic semantics before producing the correctly resolved builtin call or target-specific diagnostics.
